about: What Town Meeting voted the Department of Public Works from the general fund, mostly taxes, and how it closed, account by account.

columns.label: Transfers
columns.means: moved in or out during the year

across.label: Each department code, both years
across.note: Spent, counting what was still owed. FY2025’s report prints no orders still owed at its close, so the two years are not on one footing.

as_of: The Town’s general fund budget report at the close (period 13), unaudited.

gaps.label: Which payments make up these accounts

kicker: General fund · codes 294, 411, 421, 423, 425, 429, 433 · voted by Town Meeting
name: Department of Public Works
postings_none: The report at the close prints each account’s totals, not the payments behind them, so this page stops at the account.

read.p: Salaries and expenses as the Town numbers them. Voted plus transfers is the budget; the budget less what was spent and what was still owed is what was left.
Our department register groups these codes under one office. MUNIS keeps them as separate departments.

read.h: The two years are counted differently
read.p: FY2026’s report counts orders still owed at the close as spent. FY2025’s prints none, so a difference between the years is partly a difference in counting.

read.h: A budget line is the town’s share
read.p: Grants, fees and revolving funds that also pay for this office are not in the general fund, and are not on this page.
